queries.sql: SELECT `p`.`name`, SUM(ti.qty) as total_qty, SUM(ti.subtotal) as total_revenue FROM `transaction_items` `ti` JOIN `products` `p` ON `p`.`id` = `ti`.`product_id` JOIN `transactions` `t` ON `t`.`id` = `ti`.`transaction_id` WHERE YEAR(t.created_at) = '2025' AND MONTH(t.created_at) = '11' GROUP BY `ti`.`product_id` ORDER BY `total_qty` DESC LIMIT 10
